## Walkthrough The release updates v4.12 metadata, Go and Kubernetes dependencies, CI tooling, and the `MutableCSINodeAllocatableCount` feature gate. PV finalizer management now uses explicit JSON patches with helper and controller test coverage. ### Changes **PV finalizer JSON patching** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Finalizer patch contracts and tests**
`pkg/controller/util.go`, `pkg/controller/util_test.go`|Adds RFC 6902 patch builders for adding and removing finalizers, with handling for empty lists, missing targets, and concurrent changes.| |**Controller finalizer integration**
`pkg/controller/csi_handler.go`, `pkg/controller/csi_handler_test.go`|Replaces PV merge patches with JSONPatch operations and updates add, remove, preservation, and retry scenarios.| **Release versioning and dependencies** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Feature gate and module refresh**
`pkg/features/features.go`, `go.mod`|Promotes `MutableCSINodeAllocatableCount` to GA and enables it by default; updates the Go directive, dependencies, and Kubernetes replacement versions.| |**v4.12 changelog**
`CHANGELOG/CHANGELOG-4.12.md`|Adds v4.12.0 release notes and dependency additions, changes, and removals.| **Release tooling updates** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Workflow and builder updates**
`release-tools/.github/workflows/*`, `release-tools/cloudbuild.yaml`|Pins Codespell and Trivy actions, schedules daily Trivy scans, and updates the Cloud Build builder image.| |**Prow Go build default**
`release-tools/prow.sh`|Updates the default build Go version to 1.26.3.| **Estimated code review effort:** 3 (Moderate) | ~25 minutes ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant CSIHandler participant PatchHelpers participant KubernetesAPI CSIHandler->>PatchHelpers: Generate finalizer JSON patch PatchHelpers-->>CSIHandler: Return RFC 6902 payload CSIHandler->>KubernetesAPI: Apply JSONPatch to PersistentVolume KubernetesAPI-->>CSIHandler: Return patch result or error ``` **Suggested reviewers:** `jsafrane`, `romanbednar`
